verdict.rationale: The enterprise 'GPTs and sharing' documentation confirms that GPT builders exist and can equip custom GPTs with approved workspace apps or custom actions that call third-party APIs, but only one per GPT. That shows ChatGPT's own custom-assistant capability. The evidence does not show the specific elements of the story: custom instructions, attached knowledge, or how GPTs are shared. Sharing is suggested only by the doc's title. missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-GPT instructions, knowledge/file uploads, documented sharing or publishing flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
